title: Multi-SDK function schema validator + ergonomic invocation patterns
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a consistent, multi-language layer for validating function schemas provided to the SDKs and ergonomic helpers for invoking functions returned via model tool/function calling. This ticket covers design and prototyping in Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs; includes validation, pre-invocation checks, retries, and streaming-friendly invocation helpers.
background: We already support model-driven tool/function calling in the API. Feedback from early integrators shows pain points: inconsistent validation across SDKs, confusing invocation flow when the model emits a function call (JSON schema vs relaxed shapes), poor streaming ergonomics for long function responses, and unclear retry semantics when invoking external tools. ENG-4731 introduced basic helpers but was Python-centric and lacked multi-language parity. This ticket aims to unify patterns and provide concrete examples.
proposed_solution: Deliver: 1) A small schema validation utility in each SDK that verifies function argument objects against declared JSON Schema (with helpful error messages and repair hints), 2) High-level invocation helpers: sync_invoke / async_invoke / stream_invoke that handle validation, optional sandboxing, retries with backoff, and token-aware streaming, 3) Canonical examples and migration guide for users upgrading from ad-hoc invocation code.
decisions:
- Use JSON Schema Draft-07 as baseline for function argument validation to maximize tooling availability.
- Validation will be opt-out (enabled by default) with clear opt-out flags for performance-sensitive paths.
- Retry semantics: idempotent detection via function.metadata.idempotent boolean; if absent, default to conservative single-call (no retry).
- Streaming: provide an iterator/async iterator API that yields invocation progress events and final result; underlying streaming uses the SDK's existing realtime client where available.
acceptance_criteria: Python/TS/Go SDKs expose a validate_function_args(schema: str|dict, args: dict) -> ValidationResult API
SDK helpers include sync_invoke / async_invoke / stream_invoke with consistent signatures across languages
Validation errors include field path, expected type, and a suggested fix string
Retry logic honors function.metadata.idempotent and exposes hooks for custom backoff policies
End-to-end examples for each language in the SDK repo docs demonstrating: a) simple function call, b) function call with streaming result, c) function that requires partial retries
Performance: validation adds <0.6ms median overhead on typical 6-field payloads in release builds; measured in microbenchmarks
Tests: unit + integration tests covering schema edge cases, streaming backpressure, and retry scenarios
Docs: migration guide and example snippets added to SDK docs and quickstart
